verdict.rationale: Neon's core storage/compute engine is open source and can be compiled and run locally, so self-hosting the core is technically possible. However, the GitHub README frames local runs as being 'for small experiments and to test code changes', and the platform's other services (Auth, Functions, Object Storage, AI Gateway) are documented only as managed offerings. Missing for 10: a supported production self-hosting guide, self-hostable versions of the broader backend services, and independent hands-on reports of running Neon self-hosted in production.
